name: The Zenith Battlegrounds
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Zenith Battlegrounds! 🔥
📱💻🎮 PLAYABLE ON ALL DEVICES: Console, PC, and Mobile!

⭐ ENJOYING THE GAME?
Show your support by hitting Like and Favorite! Every bit of feedback keeps us motivated to bring you exciting updates and features. Follow the game now so you never miss a major announcement!

⚔️ CONTROLS:
ultimate mode - G
block - F
dash - Q
ragdoll cancel/evasive - Q (while ragdoll)
run - Double Tap W
punch - Left Click
emote wheel - B

💡 WALL COMBO: After 3rd hit ➔ Dash + M1

Join our group for updates and exclusive content:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/34918260/KJ-GUYS#!/about
